verses.original: Περὶ δὲ τῶν χρόνων καὶ τῶν καιρῶν ἀδελφοί οὐ χρείαν ἔχετε ὑμῖν γράφεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Peri de tōn chronōn kai tōn kairōn adelphoi ou chreian echete hymin graphesthai
verses.literal: Now about the times and seasons brothers we do not need to write to you
verses.literalPt: Mas, acerca dos tempos ou das épocas, irmãos, não tendes necessidade de que se vos escreva;

verses.original: αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἀκριβῶς οἴδατε ὅτι ἡμέρα Κυρίου ὡς κλέπτης ἐν νυκτὶ οὕτως ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: autoi gar akribōs oidate hoti hēmera Kyriou hōs kleptēs en nykti houtōs erchetai
verses.literal: For you are fully aware that the Day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night
verses.literalPt: porque vós mesmos sabeis perfeitamente que o Dia do Senhor virá como um ladrão à noite.

verses.original: ὅταν λέγωσιν Εἰρήνη καὶ ἀσφάλεια τότε αἰφνίδιος αὐτοῖς ἐφίσταται ὄλεθρος ὥσπερ ἡ ὠδὶν τῇ ἐν γαστρὶ ἐχούσῃ καὶ οὐ μὴ ἐκφύγωσιν
verses.transliteration: hotan legōsin Eirēnē kai asphaleia tote aiphnidios autois ephistatai olethros hōsper hē ōdin tē en gastri echousē kai ou mē ekphygōsin
verses.literal: While people are saying Peace and security destruction will come upon them suddenly like labor pains on a pregnant woman . . . . . . and they will not escape
verses.literalPt: Quando disserem: Paz e segurança, então, lhes sobrevirá repentinamente destruição, como as dores a uma mulher que está para dar à luz, e de modo nenhum escaparão.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἀδελφοί οὐκ ἐστὲ ἐν σκότει ἵνα ἡ ἡμέρα ὑμᾶς ὡς κλέπτης καταλάβῃ
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de adelphoi ouk este en skotei hina hē hēmera hymas hōs kleptēs katalabē
verses.literal: But you brothers are not in the darkness so that this day should overtake you like a thief
verses.literalPt: Mas vós, irmãos, não estais em trevas, para que aquele Dia, como o ladrão, vos surpreenda;

verses.original: πάντες γὰρ ὑμεῖς υἱοὶ φωτός ἐστε καὶ υἱοὶ ἡμέρας Οὐκ ἐσμὲν νυκτὸς οὐδὲ σκότους
verses.transliteration: pantes gar hymeis huioi phōtos este kai huioi hēmeras Ouk esmen nyktos oude skotous
verses.literal: For you are all sons of the light and sons of the day we do not belong . . . to the night or to the darkness
verses.literalPt: porque todos vós sois filhos da luz e filhos do dia. Nós não somos da noite nem das trevas.

verses.original: ἄρα οὖν μὴ καθεύδωμεν ὡς οἱ λοιποί ἀλλὰ γρηγορῶμεν καὶ νήφωμεν
verses.transliteration: ara oun mē katheudōmen hōs hoi loipoi alla grēgorōmen kai nēphōmen
verses.literal: So then let us not sleep as the others do but let us remain awake and sober
verses.literalPt: Assim, pois, não durmamos como os outros; antes, velemos e sejamos sóbrios.

verses.original: οἱ γὰρ καθεύδοντες νυκτὸς καθεύδουσιν καὶ οἱ μεθυσκόμενοι νυκτὸς μεθύουσιν
verses.transliteration: hoi gar katheudontes nyktos katheudousin kai hoi methyskomenoi nyktos methyousin
verses.literal: For those who sleep sleep at night and those who get drunk get drunk at night
verses.literalPt: Pois os que dormem dormem de noite, e os que se embriagam, embriagam-se de noite.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ ἡμέρας ὄντες νήφωμεν ἐνδυσάμενοι θώρακα πίστεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ περικεφαλαίαν ἐλπίδα σωτηρίας
verses.transliteration: hēmeis de hēmeras ontes nēphōmen endysamenoi thōraka pisteōs kai agapēs kai perikephalaian elpida sōtērias
verses.literal: But since we belong to the day let us be sober putting on the breastplate of faith and love and the helmet of our hope of salvation
verses.literalPt: Mas nós, porque somos do dia, sejamos sóbrios, vestindo-nos da couraça da fé e do amor e tendo por capacete a esperança da salvação.

verses.original: ὅτι οὐκ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς εἰς ὀργὴν ἀλλὰ εἰς περιποίησιν σωτηρίας διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hoti ouk etheto hēmas ho Theos eis orgēn alla eis peripoiēsin sōtērias dia tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: For God has not appointed us to suffer wrath but to obtain salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus não nos destinou para ira, mas para alcançarmos a salvação por nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo,

verses.original: τοῦ ἀποθανόντος περὶ ἡμῶν ἵνα εἴτε γρηγορῶμεν εἴτε καθεύδωμεν ἅμα σὺν αὐτῷ ζήσωμεν
verses.transliteration: tou apothanontos peri hēmōn hina eite grēgorōmen eite katheudōmen hama syn autō zēsōmen
verses.literal: He died for us so that whether we are awake or asleep we may live together with Him
verses.literalPt: que morreu por nós, para que, quer velemos, quer durmamos, vivamos juntamente com ele.

verses.original: Διὸ παρακαλεῖτε ἀλλήλους καὶ οἰκοδομεῖτε εἷς τὸν ἕνα καθὼς καὶ ποιεῖτε
verses.transliteration: Dio parakaleite allēlous kai oikodomeite heis ton hena kathōs kai poieite
verses.literal: Therefore encourage and build one another up just as you are already doing
verses.literalPt: Por isso, consolai-vos reciprocamente e edificai-vos uns aos outros, como o estais fazendo.

verses.original: Ἐρωτῶμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί εἰδέναι τοὺς κοπιῶντας ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ προϊσταμένους ὑμῶν ἐν Κυρίῳ καὶ νουθετοῦντας ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Erōtōmen de hymas adelphoi eidenai tous kopiōntas en hymin kai proistamenous hymōn en Kyriō kai nouthetountas hymas
verses.literal: But we ask you brothers to acknowledge those who work diligently among you who care for you in the Lord and who admonish you
verses.literalPt: Mas vos rogamos, irmãos, que conheçais bem aqueles que trabalham entre vós, sobre vós presidem no Senhor e vos admoestam;

verses.original: καὶ ἡγεῖσθαι αὐτοὺς ὑπερεκπερισσοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ διὰ τὸ ἔργον αὐτῶν εἰρηνεύετε ἐν ἑαυτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai hēgeisthai autous hyperekperissou en agapē dia to ergon autōn eirēneuete en heautois
verses.literal: In love hold them in highest regard because of their work Live in peace with one another
verses.literalPt: e que os prezeis muito em amor, por causa do seu trabalho. Tende paz entre vós.

verses.original: Παρακαλοῦμεν δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί νουθετεῖτε τοὺς ἀτάκτους παραμυθεῖσθε τοὺς ὀλιγοψύχους ἀντέχεσθε τῶν ἀσθενῶν μακροθυμεῖτε πρὸς πάντας
verses.transliteration: Parakaloumen de hymas adelphoi noutheteite tous ataktous paramytheisthe tous oligopsychous antechesthe tōn asthenōn makrothymeite pros pantas
verses.literal: And we urge you brothers to admonish the unruly encourage the fainthearted help the weak and be patient with everyone
verses.literalPt: Nós vos exortamos, irmãos, a que admoesteis os insubordinados, consoleis os desanimados, suporteis os fracos e sejais longânimos para com todos.

verses.original: Ὁρᾶτε μή τις κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ τινι ἀποδῷ ἀλλὰ πάντοτε τὸ ἀγαθὸν διώκετε καὶ εἰς ἀλλήλους καὶ εἰς πάντας
verses.transliteration: Horate mē tis kakon anti kakou tini apodō alla pantote to agathon diōkete kai eis allēlous kai eis pantas
verses.literal: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people
verses.literalPt: Vede que ninguém retribua a outrem mal por mal; antes, segui sempre o que é proveitoso entre vós e para com todos.

verses.original: Πάντοτε χαίρετε
verses.transliteration: Pantote chairete
verses.literal: Rejoice at all times
verses.literalPt: Alegrai-vos sempre.

verses.original: ἀδιαλείπτως προσεύχεσθε
verses.transliteration: adialeiptōs proseuchesthe
verses.literal: Pray without ceasing
verses.literalPt: Orai sem cessar.

verses.original: ἐν παντὶ εὐχαριστεῖτε τοῦτο γὰρ θέλημα Θεοῦ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: en panti eucharisteite touto gar thelēma Theou en Christō Iēsou eis hymas
verses.literal: Give thanks in every circumstance for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus
verses.literalPt: Em tudo, dai graças, porque esta é a vontade de Deus em Cristo Jesus para convosco.

verses.original: Τὸ Πνεῦμα μὴ σβέννυτε
verses.transliteration: To Pneuma mē sbennyte
verses.literal: Do not extinguish the Spirit
verses.literalPt: Não extingais o Espírito.

verses.original: προφητείας μὴ ἐξουθενεῖτε
verses.transliteration: prophēteias mē exoutheneite
verses.literal: Do not treat prophecies with contempt
verses.literalPt: Não desprezeis as profecias;

verses.original: πάντα δὲ δοκιμάζετε τὸ καλὸν κατέχετε
verses.transliteration: panta de dokimazete to kalon katechete
verses.literal: but test all things Hold fast to what is good
verses.literalPt: mas ponde tudo à prova, retende o que é bom.

verses.original: ἀπὸ παντὸς εἴδους πονηροῦ ἀπέχεσθε
verses.transliteration: apo pantos eidous ponērou apechesthe
verses.literal: Abstain from every form of evil
verses.literalPt: Abstende-vos de toda forma do mal.

verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ὁ Θεὸς τῆς εἰρήνης ἁγιάσαι ὑμᾶς ὁλοτελεῖς καὶ ὁλόκληρον ὑμῶν τὸ πνεῦμα καὶ ἡ ψυχὴ καὶ τὸ σῶμα ἀμέμπτως ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τηρηθείη
verses.transliteration: Autos de ho Theos tēs eirēnēs hagiasai hymas holoteleis kai holoklēron hymōn to pneuma kai hē psychē kai to sōma amemptōs en tē parousia tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou tērētheiē
verses.literal: Now may the God of peace Himself sanctify you completely and may your entire spirit - soul and body be kept blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ
verses.literalPt: O mesmo Deus de paz vos santifique em tudo; e o vosso espírito, alma e corpo sejam conservados completos, irrepreensíveis, para a vinda de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ καλῶν ὑμᾶς ὃς καὶ ποιήσει
verses.transliteration: pistos ho kalōn hymas hos kai poiēsei
verses.literal: The One who calls you is faithful and He will do it
verses.literalPt: Fiel é aquele que vos chama e ele também o fará.

verses.original: Ἀδελφοί προσεύχεσθε καὶ περὶ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Adelphoi proseuchesthe kai peri hēmōn
verses.literal: Brothers pray for us as well
verses.literalPt: Irmãos, orai por nós.

verses.original: Ἀσπάσασθε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς πάντας ἐν φιλήματι ἁγίῳ
verses.transliteration: Aspasasthe tous adelphous pantas en philēmati hagiō
verses.literal: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss
verses.literalPt: Saudai a todos os irmãos com um ósculo santo.

verses.original: Ἐνορκίζω ὑμᾶς τὸν Κύριον ἀναγνωσθῆναι τὴν ἐπιστολὴν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς
verses.transliteration: Enorkizō hymas ton Kyrion anagnōsthēnai tēn epistolēn pasin tois adelphois
verses.literal: I charge you before the Lord to have this letter read to all the brothers
verses.literalPt: Conjuro-vos, pelo Senhor, que se leia esta epístola a todos os irmãos.

verses.original: Ἡ χάρις τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ μεθ’ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hē charis tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou meth’ hymōn
verses.literal: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you
verses.literalPt: A graça de nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo seja convosco.
